obadiah.name: Obadiah
obadiah.role: Prophet named in the vision against Edom
obadiah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
obadiah.importance: His vision connects judgment with betrayal, seized wealth, and attacks on people escaping violence.
obadiah.connections: The book gives no parent, household, or court position. He is distinct from Ahab’s steward.
